rmse_improvement.rationale: Model must outperform persistence baseline by >= 20% to justify operational deployment.

r2_score.rationale: Model must explain >= 65% of inflow variance (baseline explains 41.83%).

conventional_wape.rationale: Conventional test-set WAPE must remain under 40% (baseline is 43.49%).

documentation_notes.wape_distinction: Conventional WAPE is 34.03% (MAE 2601.25 / mean actual 7644.19 cfs). Harshad's paired comparison CSV reported 38.50% using a fixed reference denominator of 6756.49 cfs. Both formulations demonstrate clear superiority over the persistence baseline.
documentation_notes.imputation_policy: When catchment rainfall telemetry is unavailable, missing features are imputed with training medians, and the API issues an explicit DEGRADED telemetry advisory to dam operators.
